biological.citation: Chen et al. 2020 - NCKAP1 Disruptive Variants Lead to a Neurodevelopmental Disorder with Core Features of Autism (PMID: 33157009)
biological.summary: Human brain transcriptomic data show NCKAP1 is broadly and highly expressed in prenatal and postnatal periods. Expression is enriched in excitatory neurons and radial glia and depleted in inhibitory neurons.
biological.sample_size: 21 affected individuals from 20 families (variant cohort); brain transcriptome datasets

biological.citation: Chen et al. 2020 - NCKAP1 Disruptive Variants Lead to a Neurodevelopmental Disorder with Core Features of Autism (PMID: 33157009)
biological.summary: Mouse in utero electroporation showed that Nckap1 loss of function promotes neuronal migration during early cortical development. This suggests disruptive NCKAP1 variants may cause neurodevelopmental delay or autism by altering early neuronal migration.

biological.citation: Expanding the genetic heterogeneity of intellectual disability (PMID: 28940097)
biological.summary: A heterozygous truncating NCKAP1 variant segregates fully in a large family with autosomal dominant mild intellectual disability. The authors demonstrated relevant NCKAP1 expression in human brain, supporting its candidacy.
biological.sample_size: 68 families (105 patients); one large NCKAP1 family

biological.citation: ASHG 2013 - Recurrently mutated genes contribute to the risk for developing sporadic autism spectrum disorder
biological.summary: Targeted MIP resequencing of 64 candidate genes in more than 4,000 ASD probands and 2,200 siblings implicated NCKAP1 as a novel risk locus with severe mutations in sporadic ASD.

biological.citation: Zebrafish CHD study 2020 - Systems Analysis Implicates WAVE2 Complex in the Pathogenesis of Developmental Left-Sided Obstructive Heart Defects (PMID: 32368696)
biological.summary: De novo variants in WAVE2 complex genes were enriched in left ventricular outflow tract obstruction CHD. CRISPR zebrafish knockdown showed nckap1, brk1 and wasf2 are critical for cardiac development.

biological.citation: Swaminathan et al. 2016 - The WASF3-NCKAP1-CYFIP1 Complex Is Essential for Breast Cancer Metastasis (PMID: 27432794)
biological.summary: NCKAP1 is part of the WASF3-NCKAP1-CYFIP1 complex. NCKAP1 silencing destabilizes the complex, blocks RAC1 association with it, and suppresses invasion in breast, prostate and colon cancer cells and metastasis in vivo. Stapled peptides targeting the NCKAP1-CYFIP1 interface disrupt the complex.

biological.citation: Lamellipodia-like actin networks in cells lacking WAVE regulatory complex (PMID: 35971979)
biological.summary: Disrupting the WRC subunit Nap1 (Nckap1) together with Hem1 (Nckap1l) in B16-F1 melanoma cells revealed that Arp2/3-dependent lamellipodia-like structures form without WRC. They still require Rac and Cdc42 but lack Ena/VASP recruitment.

biological.citation: Inhibition of thioredoxin reductase 1 sensitizes glucose-starved glioblastoma cells to disulfidptosis (PMID: 39715824)
biological.summary: In glucose-starved glioblastoma cells undergoing TrxR1 inhibition-induced disulfidptosis, depletion of the WAVE complex component NCKAP1 partially rescued cell death. Rac inhibition enhanced death, placing NCKAP1/WAVE-driven actin dynamics in the disulfidptosis pathway.

biological.citation: NCKAP1 improves patient outcome and inhibits cell growth by enhancing Rb1/p53 activation in hepatocellular carcinoma (PMID: 31068575)
biological.summary: In HCC cell lines and in vivo, NCKAP1 acts as a tumor suppressor. It blocks entry into G2/M and upregulates Rb1 and p53, and WASF1 was barely expressed in HCC lines.

biological.citation: MicroRNA-34c-3p promotes cell proliferation and invasion in hepatocellular carcinoma by regulation of NCKAP1 expression (PMID: 27704267)
biological.summary: NCKAP1 is a direct target of miR-34c-3p, shown by luciferase assay. High NCKAP1 in HCC tissue correlates with low miR-34c-3p and with favorable prognosis.

biological.citation: NCKAP1 is a Prognostic Biomarker for Inhibition of Cell Growth in Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma (PMID: 35957696)
biological.summary: NCKAP1 is downregulated in ccRCC and correlates with poor prognosis. Overexpression in ACHN cells reduced proliferation, invasion and migration and inhibited tumor growth in vivo. Co-expressed genes function in ribosomal signaling, oxidative phosphorylation, TGF-β and EMT pathways.
